features.title: Genuine text extraction
features.text: The converter reads the text layer of your PDF and puts that text in the ebook. It never invents content and never ships a book that silently lost pages.

features.title: EPUB 3 with a working table of contents
features.text: The output is a valid EPUB 3 package with a navigation document, an NCX fallback for older readers and minimal CSS.

features.title: Chapters grouped by page
features.text: Pages become chapters. Short documents get one chapter per page; long documents are grouped so the outline stays usable.

features.title: Limits stated up front
features.text: Up to 500 pages, 2,000,000 extracted characters, 10,000 characters per page, 120 chapters, a 5 MB package and a 45 second budget. Anything beyond that is refused instead of truncated.

how_to_use.title: Upload your PDF
how_to_use.description: Select a PDF that contains selectable text, such as an ebook export or a report saved from a word processor.

how_to_use.title: Convert to EPUB
how_to_use.description: The text layer of every page is extracted and rebuilt as chapters in an EPUB container.

how_to_use.title: Download the EPUB
how_to_use.description: Open the result in your ereader app. The download is served as application/epub+zip.

about_formats.title: What is EPUB?
about_formats.text: EPUB is the reflowable ebook standard: text adapts to the screen and the reader controls the typography.

about_formats.title: What this converter does not do
about_formats.text: It does not run OCR on scanned pages, rebuild columns or layout, carry embedded images across, or unlock protected PDFs.

faq.question: Can I convert a scanned PDF to EPUB?
faq.answer: No. A scanned page has no text layer, and this converter does not run OCR. If no selectable text is found the job is refused instead of returning an empty book.

faq.question: Will my images and charts appear in the EPUB?
faq.answer: No. This converter turns text into an ebook. Embedded images, fonts and scripts are deliberately left out of the output.

faq.question: Is the page layout preserved?
faq.answer: No, and that is the point of an ebook. The text is reflowable; page positions, columns and typography are not reproduced.

faq.question: How are chapters created?
faq.answer: From pages. Documents up to 120 pages get one chapter per page; longer documents group pages so the outline stays under 120 chapters.

faq.question: Why was my password protected PDF refused?
faq.answer: Any PDF that carries an encryption dictionary is refused, whether or not it opens with a blank password. Reading restricted content is out of scope.

faq.question: What happens if my file is too big?
faq.answer: The conversion is refused with the reason: 500 pages, 2,000,000 characters in total, 10,000 characters on one page, 120 chapters, a 5 MB package or 45 seconds of processing.

faq.question: Is PDF to EPUB free?
faq.answer: Yes. The conversion runs against Converigo from your browser and costs nothing.

faq.question: Can I convert an EPUB back to PDF?
faq.answer: Not with this tool. EPUB is an output format on Converigo, not an uploadable input.

faq.question: Are my uploaded files secure?
faq.answer: Uploads are processed for the conversion and deleted afterwards. Your file is not used for anything else.
